metadata.description: Nine Claude Code mods (UI and hook plugins) with a light Star Wars flavor.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Catches long unstructured brain dumps, asks clarifying questions with a background model, and rewrites them into a structured prompt.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Countdown until the prompt cache goes cold, with a Keep Warm button and /keep-warm command.

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: Zero-token side panel, In This Chat: goal, to-dos, connectors, skills and files.

plugins.name: droid-console
plugins.description: Restyles Claude Code as a Star Wars droid console: personality palettes, transmission headers, droid spinner words and a status band. /droid switches personality.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Builds a detailed handoff prompt at 250k tokens, on cold cache, or on /handoff, with a one-click fresh chat.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: Purple progress taskbar above the prompt plus a side panel of sub-agents with colors, progress and token cost.

plugins.name: power-cells
plugins.description: Power gauge above the prompt: context tokens left, the 5-hour limit, and a weekly pacing plan that gives you a daily ration so the 7-day limit lasts to the last minute.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Spots hard rules and preferences in your prompts and offers to save them to memory, CLAUDE.md or your second brain.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: /mods control panel: list every mod, auto-discover new ones, toggle them, hide their panels.
